brief: Sobrita: free one-action seasonal 12-costume gift, permanent ownership, equip only on owned base characters, outfit switching in existing 꾸미기 surface

displayOrder.name: 홈에서 받는 깜짝 선물
displayOrder.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality UI concept with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery and purposeful spacing.
Use case: ui-mockup.
Direction name: 홈에서 받는 깜짝 선물.
Product: Sobrita, an existing mobile budget companion with collectible pixel-art pets. Design ONE focused mobile app screen showing a seasonal costume gift invitation as a sheet above the existing home. It is an image concept, not an implemented screen.
Target dimensions: 390 x 844 logical mobile viewport, portrait aspect ratio 390:844. Render sharply at a proportional high resolution. App content only, edge-to-edge rectangular screen; no device body, bezel, notch, OS status bar, clock, battery, home indicator, outer presentation board or labels.
Input images: Image 1 is a comparison board of the existing app home; use its RIGHT-HAND implementation only as the visual reference for pixel typography, flat square controls, cream surface, teal accents and the real illustrated living room. Ignore all comparison labels and external whitespace. Image 2 is the exact Dracula Michi pixel-art character to use in the living room; preserve his appearance and costume.
Hard product rules, all essential: During the limited event users can claim all 12 character COSTUMES for free in a single action. Once claimed, costumes are permanently kept and can be changed in the existing 꾸미기 screen. Costumes do not unlock their base characters: only owned characters can wear them, and a costume for an unowned character stays saved for later. Do not show payment, advertising gates, daily missions, progress-to-unlock, expiry on owned costumes, a battle pass, or a new bottom navigation tab.
Date anchor: Today is 2026-10-23 in America/Mexico_City. Proposed seasonal acquisition window shown in the concept is 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-03. The displayed end date refers only to CLAIMING, never expiration of the costume.
Existing design system: paper #F6EFE0, paperLight #FBF5E9, surface #FFFDF7, ink #202848, muted #545E7E, teal #0E7A72, tealSoft #D8EDEA, gold #C0873A, goldSoft #F7E9CE. Square corners, crisp 2 to 3 px navy borders, tiny offset pixel shadows only on the main button. PixelifySans-style Latin and matching readable Korean pixel type, body 14–16 logical px, strong headings 24–28 px. No pill-card redesign, no glossy gradients. Real pixel-art room and pet art stay detailed.
Screen structure: existing home is still recognizable behind a cream gift sheet that occupies the lower 43 percent. Show a compact Sobrita header and settings gear, today's remaining amount in teal ($189.27 MXN), then a warm illustrated room with a comfortably sized Dracula Michi on the lavender rug. The sheet has a straight navy top rule and close control, small eyebrow "가을 축제 선물", large Korean heading "특별한 모습으로 만나요", a gold-accent line "11월 3일까지 받기 · 받은 뒤 영구 소장", and one short description "코스튬 12종을 무료로 받아요." A compact one-line helper says "보유한 캐릭터에게 입힐 수 있어요." One large full-width teal primary button reads EXACTLY "코스튬 12종 무료로 받기". Below it one quiet text action reads "나중에". A final small helper within the sheet reads "받은 의상은 꾸미기에서 언제든 바꿀 수 있어요." All words clean and readable. Keep only the existing bottom nav if enough unobscured space, with 홈, 내역, central +, 예산, 마이페이지. Do not crowd or clip.
Layout priority: one clear primary action, generous vertical spacing, calm readable financial home behind the sheet. Use shared surfaces, grouping and separators, never nested cards. Season atmosphere comes from the actual vampire pet, one small tasteful orange flower motif at the sheet edge and gold text accent; keep brand cream and teal dominant. No decoration that obscures action or labels.
Output exactly ONE mobile screen in this direction; no alternative layouts inside the image, no numbered option title, no annotations outside the app.
displayOrder.correction:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied Sobrita mobile UI concept with ONE targeted correction: replace the incorrect twelve thumbnails of different costumes on the SAME CAT with a single row of THREE accurate previews of THREE DIFFERENT existing characters, using the other supplied reference assets exactly.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact mobile UI edit target. Image 2 is Dracula Michi (navy cat with red cape). Image 3 is Frankenstein Miru (apricot poodle with green curls and purple stitched jacket). Image 4 is Catrina Lana (cream long-necked alpaca with floral purple hat and embroidered magenta dress).
Keep the mobile viewport, title, all correct Korean copy, budget home above the sheet, original illustrated living room, Dracula Michi on the rug, cream/navy/teal pixel design system, bottom nav, gold permanent-ownership line and large teal claim button as they are.
Target dimensions: 390 x 844 logical mobile app viewport, same portrait aspect ratio as Image 1. No phone body, device chrome, OS status bar or external presentation board.
Correction: Completely REMOVE the four-column by three-row grid of invented cat costumes. In its place use ONLY three compact horizontally aligned preview illustrations, exact recognizable images from refs 2, 3 and 4, one each: Dracula Michi, Frankenstein Miru, Catrina Lana. Preserve species, faces, fur, distinctive ears, original costume silhouettes; do not turn the dog or alpaca into a cat. Put a small simple label above this row reading "12종 중 미리보기". No borders or rounded cards around the three previews: directly arrange the three full-body cutouts on the existing cream sheet surface with good spacing and room for each full silhouette. Keep the row about 85 logical px tall and the illustrations consistent in apparent size. Do not invent any other costumes. The main "코스튬 12종 무료로 받기" button still claims the full 12-piece set, the three images are examples only.
Reflow the lower sheet with comfortable spacing after removal of the oversized grid; do not add filler UI. Keep "11월 3일까지 받기 · 받은 뒤 영구 소장", "보유한 캐릭터에게 입힐 수 있어요.", "나중에", and "받은 의상은 꾸미기에서 언제든 바꿀 수 있어요." readable.
Date anchor: 2026-10-23, America/Mexico_City; claim until 2026-11-03, ownership permanent after claiming.
Hard product rules: free one-action claim of 12 costumes, permanent storage, equip on owned base characters only, no payment/ad/missions/expiry of received costumes/new bottom nav.
Output ONE corrected mobile screen, no numbering or commentary in the image.

displayOrder.name: 컬렉션에서 받는 시즌 선물
displayOrder.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality UI concept with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery and purposeful spacing.
Use case: ui-mockup.
Direction name: 컬렉션에서 받는 시즌 선물.
Product: Sobrita, existing mobile budget companion and pixel-pet collection. Design ONE focused dedicated seasonal gift screen reached from the existing collection, presenting the exact 12-character costume set as a permanent gift. It is a visual concept.
Target dimensions: 390 x 844 logical mobile viewport, portrait aspect ratio 390:844, sharp proportional high resolution. App content only, rectangular edge-to-edge viewport, no phone bezel, device, notch, OS clock/status bar/battery/home indicator, outer board or external annotations.
Actual image inputs: Image 1 is the existing collection screen as visual design system reference ONLY: cream paper, navy square borders, flat teal controls and pixel typography. Ignore its mock item placeholders and distorted Spanish title. Images 2, 3, 4 are the ACTUAL character costume artwork: Dracula Michi is the navy CAT; Frankenstein Miru is the apricot POODLE with green curls; Catrina Lana is the cream ALPACA with long neck, purple flower hat and magenta dress. These three different species and costumes must be shown faithfully as the ONLY costume-preview artwork. Do not invent extra cat costumes and do not render twelve cats.
Hard product rules: during the event the user may claim all 12 COSTUMES for FREE in ONE action. Claimed costumes remain permanently owned after the event ends and can be equipped or removed in the existing 꾸미기 screen. Only owned base characters can wear their costume. Costumes for unowned characters are stored until that base character is obtained; the gift does not unlock or sell the characters. No payment, ad watching, daily missions, level gates, acquisition progress, expiry on received costumes, or new bottom-nav feature.
Date anchor: current date is 2026-10-23, America/Mexico_City. Proposed claim window is 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-03. Any date relates only to claim availability.
Design system must remain close to existing app: warm paper #F6EFE0, surface #FFFDF7, dark navy ink #202848, muted #545E7E, teal #0E7A72 and pale teal #D8EDEA, warm gold #C0873A and pale gold #F7E9CE. Crisp 2–3 px navy outlines and square corners, no rounded marketing cards, no heavy elevation. PixelifySans-style pixel Latin with readable matching Korean pixel text; body 14–16 logical px, headings 27–30 px. Strong hierarchy, lots of air, restrained festive accents.
Screen content and layout:
At top a simple back arrow and page title "시즌 선물".
A small eyebrow "HALLOWEEN × DÍA DE MUERTOS" and quiet date "10.23–11.03".
Large left-aligned Korean headline on two lines EXACTLY "이번에 받으면,
언제든 입어요."
Short supporting line "우리 친구들의 특별한 변신, 코스튬 12종".
Central generous 250-logical-px-high hero group shows the exact three supplied character costumes on the SAME cream page surface, Dracula Michi slightly larger in center, Frankenstein Miru on left, Catrina Lana on right, all full-body silhouettes visible. Keep the alpaca's long neck and ears, dog's curly ears and cat's folded ear distinct. Three previews only, no grid and no extra invented artwork. A tiny simple caption below reads "12종 중 미리보기".
Below the hero use one understated gold-tinted horizontal permanence strip with a small pixel gift icon and bold text "받은 코스튬은 영구 소장". Under it plain readable helper copy "이벤트가 끝나도 꾸미기에서 바꿔 입어요.".
Near the bottom a full-width teal square pixel button with dark navy outline and small offset pixel shadow reads EXACTLY "코스튬 12종 무료로 받기".
Under the button a calm two-line fine-print helper at 13–14 logical px reads EXACTLY "아직 없는 캐릭터의 의상도 보관돼요.
캐릭터를 얻으면 입힐 수 있어요."
One quiet text return action "컬렉션으로 돌아가기" is the only secondary action.
Use tiny orange/magenta cempasúchil floral accents at an outer page edge only, never clutter the UI.
Do not include a financial dashboard, extra cards, metrics, tabs, sample inventory, timer, progress bar, or bottom nav on this focused detail page. Never fake the hero with icons or silhouette placeholders.
Output ONE independent mobile design in this direction, no numeric option labels, no external caption, no multiple screens.

displayOrder.name: 꾸미기에서 고르는 나의 코스튬
displayOrder.prompt:
Create a realistic, production-quality UI concept with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery and purposeful spacing.
Use case: ui-mockup.
Direction name: 꾸미기에서 고르는 나의 코스튬.
Product: Sobrita mobile budget companion with an existing illustrated pet room and character collection. Design ONE focused mobile styling screen that makes permanent seasonal costume ownership and changing back to the original character immediately understandable. This is a visual concept after the seasonal costume set has already been claimed.
Target dimensions: 390 x 844 logical mobile app viewport, portrait ratio 390:844. Render at sharp proportional high resolution. App content ONLY, rectangular edge-to-edge screen, no phone frame, bezel, notch, OS status bar/time/battery, home indicator, outer board or external labels.
Actual input images: Image 1 is a comparison board showing the existing room-decorator art; use the RIGHT-HAND room as illustration/style reference. Ignore the source/implementation captions, placement '+' overlays, item slot outlines and external board whitespace. Image 2 is the exact Dracula Michi costume cat. Image 3 is the exact original/base Michi cat for the original costume thumbnail. Use these EXACT two appearances for the two wardrobe options; never invent new skins. The living room preview shows ONLY the Dracula Michi from Image 2.
Existing brand tokens: paper #F6EFE0, surface #FFFDF7, ink #202848, muted #545E7E, teal #0E7A72, pale teal #D8EDEA, gold #C0873A, pale gold #F7E9CE, line #E7DDC8. Crisp square-corner app controls with 2–3 px navy borders; dark square pixel checkmark for selection, no rounded generic cards, no gloss or heavy shadows. PixelifySans-style Latin and matching readable Korean pixel font, body 14–16 logical px, section headings 20–24. Retain warm detailed pixel living room artwork, teal curtains, window, armchair, plant and lavender rug.
Hard product model: the free seasonal set has been received and is permanently owned, including costumes of characters not yet unlocked. Equipping a costume requires ownership of the base character. Here Michi is already owned and both base and Dracula costume are available. Changing costumes belongs in the existing 꾸미기 surface, not in the acquisition collection. Nothing in this view expires after the event. Do not show prices, ads, countdowns, daily missions, a claim button, a battle pass, a new bottom-nav tab or a character purchase.
Date anchor: Today is 2026-10-23 in America/Mexico_City. The proposed acquisition event runs 2026-10-23 through 2026-11-03, but this is the post-claim wardrobe state: do NOT display an expiry date on the costume.
Layout:
Simple top bar with back arrow and title "꾸미기".
Upper roughly 300 logical px shows the existing warm living room with Dracula Michi sitting centered on the lavender rug at a natural comfortable pet scale, full body visible, original face and red cape recognizable. A small quiet "미리보기" label at the room edge.
Below the room keep existing compact category tabs "방", "가구", "벽·바닥", "소품", "캐릭터" with "캐릭터" active in teal.
A simple section header "Michi의 코스튬" and small right-side count "2벌 보유".
Directly below a quiet teal helper line "받은 의상은 이벤트가 끝나도 남아요."
Two equally sized wardrobe tiles aligned horizontally on the shared cream surface, not nested in a larger panel. Each has one exact full-body cat cutout of equal apparent size, a readable name and ownership line. Left tile uses Image 3 original base Michi, label "기본 Michi", small line "기본 모습", unselected neutral navy outline. Right tile uses Image 2 Dracula Michi, label "드라큘라 Michi", small gold label "영구 소장", selected teal outline and small square teal check in top-right. The dog/alpaca/other costume artwork must NOT appear here.
A small simple collection note "2026 가을 축제 · 소장 중" may sit under the selected tile.
Near the bottom a calm helper sentence "기본 모습도 언제든 선택할 수 있어요."
One large full-width teal primary button with a navy pixel outline reads EXACTLY "이 코스튬 입히기".
No extra section, duplicate action or bottom navigation. Keep all text clearly readable, adequate touch target sizes and generous spacing. Do not add random decorations or a dozen thumbnails to fill space. Nothing cropped. Match the app's cream/navy/teal pixel look, not a generic smooth modern UI.
Output exactly ONE complete mobile screen in this direction, no numeric option labels, no annotations, no multiple screens.
